rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person’s grateful appreciation, especially in phrases such as 對某人嘅感激.

example.english: I have always felt gratitude toward you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 nei5 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5 gam2 gik1

rows.note: Choose this when the gratitude has a reflective, moral, or appreciative-of-life flavour rather than simply thanking someone.

example.english: After going through this, I have learned greater gratitude.
example.traditional: 經歷過呢件事，我更加懂得感恩。
example.jyutping: ging1 lik6 gwo3 ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 gang3 gaa1 dung2 dak1 gam2 jan1

rows.note: Use this for a formal or written expression of thanks, such as conveying or expressing gratitude to someone.

example.english: I hereby extend my gratitude to everyone.
example.jyutping: gan2 ci2 hoeng3 gok3 wai2 zi3 soeng6 ze6 ji3
